items.title: Coinbase stock sinks as weak crypto market leads to another quarterly loss
items.summary: Coinbase Global stock tumbled early Friday after the company posted a wider-than-expected second quarter net loss on Thursday, marking its third quarter in the red since the crypto market began to draw down from its October highs.
